name: Nail
description: "Well struck!" A phrase passed from master to student. What could be nobler than a nail given purpose?

abilities.name: Guard Breaker
abilities.description: When making an attack roll against the most recent bug(s) the Nailsbug has dealt damage to, 4s are counted as successes.

abilities.name: Battle Stance
abilities.description: When a bug enters a square adjacent to the Nailmaster from a square not adjacent to them, it provokes an attack of opportunity.

abilities.name: Martial Master
abilities.description: The Nailsage may perform an additional Art per turn.
